speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. To start, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool appearance, such as dark, tarry stools or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the severity of these symptoms. Have you noticed any pain when swallowing, difficulty swallowing food, or any change in the size of your neck lymph nodes? Also, do you have a history of heavy smoking or alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR).
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound, Chest CT.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Lymphoma.
